Happy Birthday
Amy

A little winter fairy tale, made just for you.

Once upon a time in a small village in the land of pandas.
…there lived a girl named Amy
Born with a desire to travel the world
Where every little moment felt like magic
Half explorer, half mermaid at heart
Beneath a sky full of wishes
Happy Birthday,
Amy
May all your dreams come true ✨
@keyframes tw{0%,100%{opacity:.15;transform:scale(.7);}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.25);}} /* frost corners */ .frostc{position:absolute;width:230px;height:230px;z-index:1;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none; background:radial-gradient(circle at 0 0,rgba(205,238,255,.6),transparent 60%);} .frostc.tl{top:0;left:0;} .frostc.tr{top:0;right:0;transform:scaleX(-1);} .frostc.bl{bottom:0;left:0;transform:scaleY(-1);} .frostc.br{bottom:0;right:0;transform:scale(-1);} #snow{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;} /* INTRO */ #intro{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:30;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center; gap:24px;padding:24px;text-align:center;transition:opacity .8s;} .flake-big{font-size:3.2rem;color:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px var(--glow));animation:spin 16s linear infinite;} @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}} #intro h1{ font-family:'Cinzel Decorative',serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,7vw,4.2rem);letter-spacing:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,var(--ice) 50%,var(--ice-deep)); -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent; text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(168,224,255,.4);} #intro .sub{color:#cfe8ff;font-size:1.05rem;opacity:.85;max-width:420px;} .btn{font-family:'Cinzel Decorative',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;color:#0a2440;letter-spacing:1px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,var(--ice) 60%,var(--ice-deep));border:none;padding:15px 44px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 8px 34px rgba(126,200,227,.5),inset 0 1px 0 #fff;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;} .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 12px 44px rgba(168,224,255,.7),inset 0 1px 0 #fff;} .btn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.99);} /* MOVIE */ #movie{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 0.5s;} .scene{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center; gap:26px;padding:6vh 6vw;text-align:center;opacity:0;transform:scale(1.07);transition:opacity 1.1s,transform 1.3s;} .scene.active{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);pointer-events:auto;} .line{font-family:'Cinzel Decorative',serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px; color:#fff;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4.6vw,2.7rem);line-height:1.25;max-width:16ch; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,var(--ice) 60%,#bfe6ff); -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent; text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(168,224,255,.35));} .opening{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,6.5vw,3.6rem);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;max-width:25ch;} .small{font-family:'Quicksand';font-weight:500;color:#dbefff;font-size:1.15rem;opacity:.92;} /* photo frame in ice */ .frame{width:min(64vw,400px);aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:18px;background-size:cover;background-position:center; background-color:#0e2547;position:relative; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.9),0 0 0 9px rgba(126,200,227,.35),0 0 60px rgba(168,224,255,.55),0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);} .frame.wide{aspect-ratio:4/3;width:min(74vw,520px);} .frame .glint{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;} .frame .glint::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-30%; background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 42%,rgba(255,255,255,.4) 50%,transparent 58%); background-size:250% 250%;animation:glint 4s ease-in-out infinite;} @keyframes glint{0%{transform:translate(40%,40%);}100%{transform:translate(-40%,-40%);}} .frame .ice{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:18px;pointer-events:none; background:radial-gradient(120% 120% at 0 0,rgba(205,238,255,.35),transparent 35%), radial-gradient(120% 120% at 100% 100%,rgba(205,238,255,.3),transparent 35%); mix-blend-mode:screen;} /* finale */ #finaleTitle{font-family:'Cinzel Decorative',serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(2.3rem,9.5vw,5.8rem);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:2px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,var(--ice) 50%,var(--ice-deep)); -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 34px rgba(168,224,255,.6));} /* ice cake */ .icecake{width:min(46vw,230px);margin-bottom:6px;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45)) drop-shadow(0 0 26px rgba(168,224,255,.5));animation:floaty 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;} @keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateY(-9px);}} .icecake .flame{transform-origin:center bottom;animation:flick .32s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transition:opacity .5s,transform .5s;} .icecake .smoke{opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s;} .icecake.out .flame{opacity:0;transform:scaleY(.15);} .icecake.out .glowfl{opacity:0;} .icecake.out .smoke{opacity:.9;} @keyframes flick{from{transform:scaleY(1) scaleX(1);}to{transform:scaleY(1.2) scaleX(.88) translateY(-1px);}} #fx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:20;pointer-events:none;} #hud{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:25;padding:14px 18px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:12px;} #bar{flex:1;height:5px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);overflow:hidden;} #fill{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ice-deep),#fff);transition:width 0.1s linear;} .ctl{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:#eaf7ff;border-radius:99px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.9rem;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);transition:background 0.2s;} .ctl:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);} #replay{position:absolute;z-index:26;left:50%;bottom:13%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:none;font-family:'Quicksand';}

Amy

Beneath a sky full of wishes
Happy Birthday,
Amy
